title: fix(media,cli): keep Unicode filenames on raw uploads (RFC 8187 filename*)
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Fixed raw uploads of filenames containing CJK characters or emoji in the polli CLI: it sends the UTF-8 name using RFC 8187 `Content-Disposition: filename*`, avoiding a local ByteString header error. The media service decodes `filename*` for `POST /upload` and falls back to the unchanged `X-File-Name` behavior when it is missing or invalid. The CLI still sends `X-File-Name` for ASCII and Latin-1 names for compatibility with older media servers; it omits that header for names that cannot be sent safely. CORS now permits `Content-Disposition`. Streaming is unchanged, as are multipart and JSON uploads.
